entries.title: Clearer words in every language
entries.body: In the nine languages besides English, lines that said something different from the English now say the same thing. Among them are the line about a computer that is out of reach, a waiting copy's status, how often a batch of approved changes merges, and the jobs that stop when you update. Words for a computer, a phone, the record, pinned models, Not now and the Secrets section now match the rest of each language.
entries.noPicture: Only the words of existing lines change, in languages other than English; the layout stays the same.
